title: Recovered craft cannot be flown because consciousness pilots them

tellings.quote: they they they obviously ran into a major problem uh that they weren't able to Pilot the craft because it's Consciousness that Pilots the craft

plain: The people in the United States who hold recovered alien craft cannot fly them, because the craft are steered by consciousness, the mind itself, rather than by controls. A lawyer named Dan Sheehan says he was told this, describing it as "a major problem" for those trying to fly the craft.
